lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. Hai tempo? A riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Come ti chiami?
lines.translation: Hello! I'm Flick. Do you have time? A riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more minute. What's your name?
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain leaks with municipal confidence. Flick darts through the corner of your vision; a tiny firecracker pops where he ought to be.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Una foglia? Ooh, distraction: ten out of ten. Mi chiedi di guardare, ma io continuo a muovermi! Can you make me stop? A riddle: what never stays—wait, another leaf.
lines.translation: I'm looking! At what? A leaf? Ooh, distraction: ten out of ten. You're asking me to look, but I keep moving! Can you make me stop? A riddle: what never stays—wait, another leaf.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where supervision is largely theoretical.

lines.native: Mi fermo! Va bene. A riddle: where does a stopped Letharger—oh, a moth. Dove vado? Indicami la direzione! Then five more minutes. Your attention span is getting suspiciously good.
lines.translation: I’m stopping! All right. A riddle: where does a stopped Letharger—oh, a moth. Where do I go? Show me the direction! Then five more minutes. Your attention span is getting suspiciously good.
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker lands beside your shoe, apparently to commemorate the achievement of doing nothing.

lines.native: “Left”? In inglese! Non capisco la direzione. Dove vado? In italiano, per favore! A riddle: which road—ooh, wings. Just five more minutes. No rush.
lines.translation: “Left”? In English! I don't understand the direction. Where do I go? In Italian, please! A riddle: which road—ooh, wings. Just five more minutes. No rush.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already at the edge of your vision, inspecting a moth with no apparent qualifications.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! La direzione è giusta. Ma partiamo domani, va bene? Prima una pausa! A riddle: what has no hurry and—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes. Poi andiamo, promesso!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! The direction is correct. But let's leave tomorrow, okay? First, a break! A riddle: what has no hurry and—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes. Then we'll go, promise!
lines.narrative: Flick drifts left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces a delay nobody requested.

lines.native: Domani? Sì! Domani va bene! Ma vuoi partire oggi? Io preferisco aspettare. A riddle: what comes after—ooh, sparks. Just five more minutes. Vuoi partire o vuoi aspettare?
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes! Tomorrow is fine! But do you want to leave today? I prefer to wait. A riddle: what comes after—ooh, sparks. Just five more minutes. Do you want to leave or do you want to wait?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is elsewhere, having mistaken the fuse for a destination.

lines.native: Adesso? Sì, hai ragione! Non domani. Andiamo a sinistra, adesso! You win. A riddle: what finally moves when—oh, that's me. This is so random.
lines.translation: Now? Yes, you're right! Not tomorrow. Let's go left, now! You win. A riddle: what finally moves when—oh, that's me. This is so random.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, apparently hoping the present will leave without him.
